name: How long does it take to close on a new construction property once I've made a reservation?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to close on a new construction property once I've made a reservation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The closing timeline for a new construction property, once you've made a reservation, can vary significantly depending on the project's stage and developer. For pre-construction, it could be 12 to 36 months or more until completion and closing. For properties already under construction, the timeline might be shorter, perhaps 3 to 12 months. It's essential to understand the developer's estimated completion date and any potential delays. We help track these timelines and keep you informed throughout the build process until the final closing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Closing on new construction can take 3 to over 36 months, depending on the project stage; pre-construction takes longer.
